name: Virginia MetalFab
old_description: Virginia MetalFab has been in the metal fabrication industry since 2002, always striving to offer quality products in a timely manner for our customers. But it has always been about a lot more than just that for us. We believe that in order to provide such a quality service we must always be striving for excellence on a personal level, being involved in and contributing to our community, and working toward the success of our customers.
about:
Virginia MetalFab was founded in 2002 in Appomattox, Virginia, as a family-owned operation focused on supplying the equine industry with high-quality manufactured and customized products. The company has since expanded its scope while retaining its original ownership structure and values rooted in Christian faith.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services under one roof, including fiber laser cutting, sheet metal forming, CNC turret punching, tube laser cutting, welding and fabrication, and powder coating. Production relies on equipment such as Amada press brakes and an Amada turret punch press, though the company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

While the equine sector remains part of its history, Virginia MetalFab now serves customers in energy, utilities, transportation, and technology. References from clients such as Stadco, ShieldCo, and Accredited Home Elevator illustrate the breadth of its customer base.

The company emphasizes a partnership model, citing intentionality, professionalism, and a customer-first philosophy as differentiators. It describes its success as tied directly to the success of its customers, a principle reinforced by its family-owned culture and a feature in The FABRICATOR highlighting its commitment to innovation.
